item.title: 119. Amy McCord Jones, Owner of Flower Moxie
item.description: Please welcome Amy McCord Jones, Owner of Flower Moxie. Flower Moxie is an online business that sells flowers to DIY brides and helps them put it all together using recipes and tutorials. Flower Moxie’s success shows that you can absolutely create something brave and unrepresented from scratch, keep the daily operations small, but scale the impact nationwide.

item.title: 120. Kim Estep, Founder of Women Nation
item.description: Please welcome Kim Estep, Founder of Women Nation, a soon to be released podcast. Kim Estep has worked in the commercial finance industry for over 22 years and attributes her success to understanding and adapting to the male professional psyche.

item.title: 121. Pavel Stepanov, CEO of Virtudesk
item.description: Please welcome Pavel Stepanov, CEO of Virtudesk. When he was still working as a real estate agent, hiring his first VA made him realize that virtual assistants can help save time and money, which contributes to increasing business productivity and growth. He has been able to grow Virtudesk to over 700 employees without funding, since the cost-effectiveness of virtual assistants allows him to reinvest revenue back into the business to grow it. Now, Virtudesk has been included in this year’s Inc.

item.title: 122. Dr. Chandler Sims Chang, Clinical Psychologist & CEO of Therapy Lab & Therapy Lab Kids
item.description: Please welcome Dr. Chandler Sims Chang, Clinical Psychologist and CEO of Therapy Lab and Therapy Lab Kids. Therapy Lab Kids aims to address the mental health challenges families in America face by providing accessible therapy. On this episode, we will be discussing culture in the virtual workspace and avoiding burnout.

item.title: 123. Kwini Reed, Owner of Poppy + Rose and Poppy & Seed
item.description: Please welcome Kwini Reed, Owner of Poppy + Rose and Poppy & Seed. Kwini’s path to becoming a renowned restauranteur has been untraditional, as she started her career in the entertainment industry, singing in venues throughout the country and writing music for film and TV shows.

item.title: 124. Ron Rudzin, Founder & CEO of Saatva
item.description: Please welcome Ron Rudzin, Founder & CEO of Saatva. Saatva has been the fastest-growing online brand in the bedroom category over the pandemic, growing to over $420M in revenue in 2021. This year, Saatva is eyeing half a billion in revenue. Utilizing technology, Saatva creates experiences in their stores where tech, luxury and comfort collide.

item.title: 125. Benson Tsai, CEO of Stellar Pizza
item.description: Please welcome Benson Tsai, CEO of Stellar Pizza. Stellar Pizza uses cutting-edge technology and advanced robotics to create an automated, touchless machine, offering a one-of-a-kind technology-driven culinary experience that bakes and serves pizza from scratch in under five minutes.

item.title: 126. Jason White, CEO of The Federal Code
item.description: Please welcome Jason White, CEO of The Federal Code. Jason is an expert in the federal contracting process. He has nearly 13 years' experience helping businesses succeed with government contracts. Jason is the AUTHORITY in formulating strategies to increase APPROVAL in Federal Government contract bids. He equips entrepreneurs, business owners, 9-5ers, and anyone who desires to supply products and services to the Federal Government with the knowledge and resources to make it happen.

item.title: 127. Emilia M. D'Anzica and Sabina M. Pons, Authors of "Pressing ON as a Tech Mom"
item.description: Please welcome Emilia M. D'Anzica and Sabina M. Pons, Authors of "Pressing ON as a Tech Mom: How Tech Industry Mothers Set Goals, Define Boundaries & Raise the Bar for Success." This book is not just about women in tech. It's about technology moms and the struggles and triumphs that they experienced throughout their careers, as well as allies of tech moms who want to support this movement

item.title: 128. Alexander Melton, CEO & Founder of Wyrmix
item.description: Please welcome Alexander Melton, CEO & Founder of Wyrmix, a creative technology engineering studio based out of Dallas, TX that that leverages their partnerships to create physical and digital products, connected experiences, and interactive environments.
